title: Dealer dashboard: show which offers are undercut
description: Dealers ask why their offers rank low. New `GET /api/dealer/offers/benchmark` lists the dealer's active offers with the best leasing factor any other dealer has for the same vehicle and terms, and whether they are undercut. Test included.

defects.explanation: Runs one min() query per offer inside the map; a dealer with hundreds of offers makes hundreds of queries. Compute the best factors in one grouped query.
